description_en: Retrieves the traffic trend of a virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw describe-vpc-firewall-traffic-trend --lang zh --start-time 1780626107 --end-time 1767493189 --vpc-id vpc-j6cnofg4lg1ujx3xj0000 --peer-vpc-id vpc-j6c7mscdg4hfqanfi0000 --private-ip 10.21.186.XXX --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVpcFirewallTrafficTrend

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：表示中文
en：表示英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The start time. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间。使用秒级时间戳格式表示
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。使用秒级时间戳格式表示
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the VPC-connected instance
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the peer VPC instance
parameters.name: peer_vpc_id
